def smallest_change(arr):

        changes = 0
        while left < right:
            if arr[left] != arr[right]:
                changes += 1
            left += 1
            right -= 1
        return changes
    
    middle = len(arr) // 2
    left = middle - 1 if len(arr) % 2 == 0 else middle
    right = middle + 1 if len(arr) % 2 == 0 else middle
    
    return count_changes(left, right)
